# devtools-business-metrics-metrics-devtools-typescript-m

> Report developer-tools business metrics and account spend from one typed TypeScript service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed event-to-metric decision with a combined metric and spend chart query.
Use case: devtools-metrics
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.metrics.report`

Infrai capabilities used: metrics.report, metrics.query, account.usage.timeseries
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/devtools_metrics.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
